commits.message: Final commit

Added css paths, fixed collectstatic,
fixed chat queries bug,
overall fixes

Session leader now can kill characters, give and take items, level up and level down them.

Characters when are killed could only comment while being in game. Session leader may revive them, but he is not obliged to. After session end, all killed characters will be removed.

Changed stile of detailed view for all models, added visible links to related models.

Added sign up style.
Added invitations.
Changed models interaction. Now Character is
related to one Player only.
HTML and CSS redesign.

Changed database settings.

Added validation to fields.

visualisation.

if user is allowed to delete object.

Created message model and form, which was
implemented as part of session.

Added chat to session play view.

used for participation.

with every view now having it's own function.

Changed models, every element of game, which
has it's author, will be noted in model.

removal of sessions.

future expansion.
